create.name: Lama Padma Samten
create.bio:
Lama Padma Samten, born Alfredo Aveline, is a Brazilian teacher of Tibetan Buddhism. He trained as a physicist at the Federal University of Rio Grande do Sul, taking his bachelor's and master's degrees there, and taught physics from 1969 until 1994; his study of quantum theory drew him towards Buddhist thought. In 1986 he founded the Centro de Estudos Budistas Bodisatva (CEBB). Chagdud Tulku Rinpoche accepted him as a student in 1993 and ordained him a lama in 1996. He lives in Viamão, Rio Grande do Sul, where he directs the Instituto Caminho do Meio, the CEBB's main seat.

The CEBB has since spread to groups and retreat villages in many Brazilian states, and Lama Samten travels between them giving talks, courses and residential retreats, many also streamed online, with a strong interest in a culture of peace and in how practice shapes everyday relationships. His Portuguese-language books include A Roda da Vida, O Lama e o Economista and Meditando a Vida. His YouTube channel, running since 2009 with several thousand uploads, carries recorded retreats and courses from CEBB centres and a daily puja broadcast, all in Portuguese.

courses.title: Retiro de Verão 2027 | CEBB Caminho do Meio
courses.description: Lama Padma Samten's traditional ten-day summer retreat at the CEBB's seat in Viamão, open to beginners and experienced students, in person or online. Days alternate teachings, sitting meditation, morning and evening pujas and questions.

free_resources.title: Puja Diário | Online
free_resources.description: A daily online practice led by Lama Padma Samten at 5.30 in the morning and 7 in the evening, open to anyone. It began in April 2020 and has continued every day since, with mantra recitation and short Tibetan liturgies.
